# android

Mirror an Android phone over adb with scrcpy: screen, front camera, and "throw this YouTube URL on the phone" shortcuts.

---

## `android_list_devices`

Print the serial of every connected adb device, one per line.

**Usage**

```sh
android_list_devices
```

**Examples**

```sh
android_list_devices
adb -s "$(android_list_devices | head -n 1)" shell getprop ro.product.model
```

**Requires** `adb`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/android.sh:31`](../../modules/common/android.sh#L31)

---

## `android_mirror`

Mirror the phone screen in a floating, titled window. Any extra arguments are passed straight through to scrcpy.

**Usage**

```sh
android_mirror [scrcpy-args...]
```

**Examples**

```sh
android_mirror
android_mirror --max-size=1024 --turn-screen-off
```

**Requires** `scrcpy`, `adb`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/android.sh:43`](../../modules/common/android.sh#L43)

**See also** `android_mirror_camera`

---

## `android_mirror_camera`

Mirror the phone's front camera as a square, rotated feed — useful as a webcam source. Extra arguments pass through to scrcpy.

**Usage**

```sh
android_mirror_camera [scrcpy-args...]
```

**Examples**

```sh
android_mirror_camera
android_mirror_camera --camera-facing=back --camera-ar=16:9
```

**Requires** `scrcpy`, `adb`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/android.sh:55`](../../modules/common/android.sh#L55)

**See also** `android_mirror`

---

## `android_open_youtube`

Open a YouTube URL in the phone's YouTube app, then mirror the screen with the URL in the window title. Extra arguments pass through to scrcpy.

**Usage**

```sh
android_open_youtube <url> [scrcpy-args...]
```

**Examples**

```sh
android_open_youtube https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ
android_open_youtube https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ --max-size=1024
```

**Requires** `adb`, `scrcpy`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/android.sh:73`](../../modules/common/android.sh#L73)

**See also** `android_mirror`
